requiredFindings.problem: The cancellation paragraph, as S18 and S21 assemble it, says a commit whose FinalGate was latched after admission stays committed and is operational-failed (4) through DELIVERY.REQUIRED_FAILED, with its runId. The same paragraph still ends with the parent sentence "Per kind: an analysis attempt aborts and leaves no Run". That sentence is WS:229 and, on the effective copy, WSE:233. Both lines are free. For the latched-after-admission case the attempt stays committed and keeps its runId, so it does not abort and it does not leave no Run. For an undetermined commit the attempt stays admitted and the caller receives DURABILITY.COMMIT_FAILED (IE:96, IE:1680-1681); that row is the durability termination, and the attempt is not aborted. Line 226 says those two outcomes govern instead of the interrupted aggregate. It does not qualify the per-kind sentence, which remains an unqualified claim about every analysis attempt. LD-6 reads that sentence as only the case the signal aborts and parks a later edit as cross-law item 6. That qualification is absent from the WS and WSE lines. J3d's signal wiring, which waits on S21, would still have a same-paragraph rule that drops the Run.
requiredFindings.evidence: WS:229 and WSE:233 are each the exact line "Per kind: an analysis attempt aborts and leaves no Run; an import discards its". S18 binds WS 225, 227, 228, 231 and 1393, and WSE 225, 229, 230, 235 and 1466, so WS:229 and WSE:233 are outside S18. PASSAGES.md prints both assembled paragraphs with S21's exception and then "Per kind: an analysis attempt aborts and leaves no Run". SL:552-554 keeps a state-3 commit committed with its RunId and reports required delivery through DELIVERY.REQUIRED_FAILED. X3D:283 and X7:101 give CommitUndetermined operational-failed 4, DURABILITY.COMMIT_FAILED, durability-commit, the ExecutionId, and no RunId. J1:868 requires the exception and leaves S18's lines; it does not require this per-kind sentence to stay unqualified.
